error.unavailable: We cannot make your plan right now. Please try again later.

strong.means: You owe little or nothing compared with what you earn.
strong.improve: Keep it that way. Do not take new loans before you leave.

fair.means: Your debt is a few months of your pay. It is a weight, but you can carry it.
fair.improve: Pay the debt with the highest interest first, and ask the lender to write the interest rate down.

weak.means: Your debt is many months of your pay. This is the biggest risk to your plan.
weak.improve: Do not borrow more. Talk to a worker support group before you pay anything new, and keep every receipt.

strong.means: Your savings cover several months of your costs. That is a strong cushion.
strong.improve: Keep this money apart from the money you send home.

fair.means: Your savings cover a month or two of costs. That helps, but a long problem would use it up.
fair.improve: Add a little every month until it covers three months of costs.

weak.means: You have almost nothing saved for a bad month.
weak.improve: Start with a small amount from your first pay, even a very small one, and add each month.

remittance_ratio.name: Money sent home compared with your pay

strong.means: The share of your pay you plan to send home leaves room to live.
strong.improve: Keep sending the same amount each month, on the same day.

fair.means: You plan to send a large part of your pay. It leaves little room for surprises.
fair.improve: Check your costs for the first month before you decide the exact amount.

weak.means: You plan to send almost all of your pay, or more than you can afford.
weak.improve: Send a smaller amount at first. Raise it once you know your real costs.

recruitment_fee_vs_cap.name: Agent fee compared with the usual limit

strong.means: What you paid your agent is at or under what the host country usually allows.
strong.improve: Keep your receipts and your contract together.

fair.means: What you paid your agent is a little above the usual limit.
fair.improve: Keep every receipt and ask a worker support group if the fee was explained to you.

weak.means: What you paid your agent is far above what the host country usually allows.
weak.improve: Keep every receipt and message from the agent, and ask a worker support group for help. Do not pay more.

strong.means: You have a bank account, so your pay and savings are safe and easy to show.
strong.improve: Keep the account in your own name and keep the card yourself.

fair.means: You have a mobile wallet but no bank account. It is a start.
fair.improve: Ask about a bank account that your employer can pay into.

weak.means: You have no bank account or wallet to be paid into.
weak.improve: Open a bank account or wallet in your own name before you leave, or in your first week.
